description: Hello! I am a solo participant from Tanzania passionate about space storytelling. I chose "Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars".I love Writing & Communications, Arts & Multimedia, Graphic Design, and Web Development. I will build an interactive storytelling website that brings abandoned NASA equipment to life with short stories, pictures, and fun facts for young people. Beginner but very motivated to learn.
summary:
Skyler - Moon and Mars Treasure Hunt is a fun story website for school kids aged 8-14. We tell stories about real NASA equipment left in space.

1. The Moon Buggy - Astronauts left a car on the Moon in 1971. It is still there!
2. Opportunity Rover - A robot car on Mars that worked for 15 years. It is now sleeping on Mars.
3. Apollo 11 Footprints - The first footprints on the Moon. They will stay for 100 million years!

Kids open our website, choose Moon or Mars, and read a short story. Our goal is to make kids love space and dream to be astronauts one day.

We used Google Sites to build the website. Team Skyler from Tanzania.
details: Our website is for kids. It has a short space story, a Moon and Mars buggy, and a quiz. Kids read, play and learn about space. We used Google Sites. Team Skyler from Tanzania wants kids to love space and dream to be astronauts.
